otr_ema_v0_y1.description: 29. Native Exponential Moving Average (EMA) price balancing current price with dynamic 1-year historical averages.

otr_ema_v1_m3.description: 30. Exact mathematical Exponential Moving Average (EMA) price utilizing static alpha over row indices.
otr_ema_v1_m3.business_logic: SUM((otr_price * alpha_v1) / (1 - alpha_v1)^row_idx) weighted backward recursively.

otr_ema_v1_m6.description: 31. Exact mathematical Exponential Moving Average (EMA) price utilizing static alpha (0.011) over 6 months lookback.
otr_ema_v1_m6.business_logic: SUM((otr_price * alpha_v1_m6) / (1 - alpha_v1_m6)^row_idx) weighted backward recursively.

otr_ema_v1_y1.description: 32. Exact mathematical Exponential Moving Average (EMA) price utilizing static alpha (0.00546) over 1 year lookback.
otr_ema_v1_y1.business_logic: SUM((otr_price * alpha_v1_y1) / (1 - alpha_v1_y1)^row_idx) weighted backward recursively.

otr_ewm_base_m6.description: 33. 6-month exponentially weighted moving average price under normal time decay configurations.
otr_ewm_base_m6.business_logic: SUM(otr_price * (weight_i_normal / weight_accum_normal)) over a 6-month range window.

otr_ewm_fast_m6.description: 34. 6-month exponentially weighted moving average price heavily focused on rapid adaptation to current asset trends.
otr_ewm_fast_m6.business_logic: SUM(otr_price * (weight_i_fast_update / weight_accum_fast)) over a 6-month range window.

otr_ewm_slow_m6.description: 35. 6-month exponentially weighted moving average price accentuating older historical baseline values.
otr_ewm_slow_m6.business_logic: SUM(otr_price * (weight_i_slow_living / weight_accum_slow)) over a 6-month range window.

otr_ewm_base_y1.description: 36. 1-year exponentially weighted moving average price under normal time decay configurations.
otr_ewm_base_y1.business_logic: SUM(otr_price * (weight_i_normal / weight_accum_normal)) over a 12-month range window.

otr_ewm_fast_y1.description: 37. 1-year exponentially weighted moving average price heavily focused on rapid adaptation to current asset trends.
otr_ewm_fast_y1.business_logic: SUM(otr_price * (weight_i_fast_update / weight_accum_fast)) over a 12-month range window.

otr_ewm_slow_y1.description: 38. 1-year exponentially weighted moving average price accentuating older historical baseline values.
otr_ewm_slow_y1.business_logic: SUM(otr_price * (weight_i_slow_living / weight_accum_slow)) over a 12-month range window.
